title: Fix non-functional submit button and comment list creation in Admin Panel

requirements.text: Fix the 'Choose a list...' button in the 'Create New Comment List' section so that clicking it successfully creates a new comment list with the entered name (e.g., 'App7') and triggers the backend storage operation

quotes: When I enter app name and click on submit button nothing happens
when i click the submit button so the app list shown below automatic before

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the 'Choose a list...' button with a valid list name creates the comment list
The button click handler properly triggers the form submission
Backend successfully stores the new comment list
User receives visual feedback (success message or loading state) during creation

requirements.text: Make newly created comment lists automatically appear in the 'Manage Existing Lists' dropdown immediately after creation without requiring a page refresh

quotes: when i click the submit button so the app list shown below automatic before

acceptanceCriteria: After creating a list like 'App7', it immediately appears in the 'Select List' dropdown under 'Manage Existing Lists'
The dropdown updates without requiring manual refresh
React Query cache is invalidated to fetch the updated list

requirements.text: Fix all button click event handlers throughout the Admin Panel to ensure they respond properly when clicked in production deployment

quotes: I mean button not work only
Button click handlers aren't triggering properly

acceptanceCriteria: All buttons in the Admin Panel respond to click events
Click handlers execute their intended actions consistently
No console errors related to event handler binding
Buttons work identically in both draft and production environments

requirements.text: Optimize frontend performance to reduce response time and eliminate UI glitches, particularly focusing on form submission and list rendering operations

quotes: just update and remove glitches or bugs from websites also reduce response time

acceptanceCriteria: Form submissions complete within 2 seconds under normal conditions
UI updates render smoothly without flickering or layout shifts
Loading states are displayed during async operations
No visual glitches during list creation or dropdown population

requirements.text: Clear the list name input field after successfully creating a new comment list to allow immediate creation of another list
acceptanceCriteria: Input field clears automatically after successful list creation
User can immediately enter a new list name without manual clearing
Form state resets properly after submission

constraints: Maintain the existing single-actor Motoko backend architecture
Do not modify the Internet Identity authentication system (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts)
Preserve the admin token authorization system
Keep the existing UI component structure from shadcn/ui
Maintain compatibility with the device-based single-use tracking system
nonGoals: Redesigning the Admin Panel UI layout or visual styling
Adding new comment list features beyond creation and display
Adding user notifications or toast systems
Modifying the backend data model or API structure beyond bug fixes
